endorsements.name: Kévin Mosbahi
endorsements.label: CVE-2024-11353
endorsements.description: The SMS for Lead Capture Forms plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthorized modification of data due to a missing capability check on the delete_message() function in all versions up to, and including, 1.1.0. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above, to delete arbitrary messages.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 4.3)

endorsements.name: Kévin Mosbahi
endorsements.label: CVE-2024-11443
endorsements.description: The de:branding plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthorized modification of data that can lead to privilege escalation due to a missing capability check on the debranding_save() function in all versions up to, and including, 1.0.2. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to update arbitrary options on the WordPress site. This can be leveraged to update the default role for registration to administrator and enable user registration for attackers to gain administrative user access to a vulnerable site.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 8.8)

endorsements.name: Kévin Mosbahi
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-1314
endorsements.description: The Custom Twitter Feeds – A Tweets Widget or X Feed Widget plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Cross-Site Request Forgery in all versions up to, and including, 2.2.5. This is due to missing or incorrect nonce validation on the ctf_clear_cache_admin() function. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to reset the plugin's cache via a forged request granted they can trick a site administrator into performing an action such as clicking on a link.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 4.3)
